snippets.traefik:
http:
  routers:
    agent-office:
      rule: "Host(`office.example.invalid`)"
      entryPoints: [websecure]
      service: agent-office
      tls:
        certResolver: letsencrypt
  services:
    agent-office:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://127.0.0.1:45863"
snippets.cloudflare:
cloudflared tunnel login
cloudflared tunnel create agent-office
cloudflared tunnel route dns agent-office office.example.invalid
# Configure the named tunnel before running:
cloudflared tunnel run agent-office
snippets.cloudflareConfig:
tunnel: <TUNNEL-UUID>
credentials-file: <CREDENTIALS-JSON-PATH>
ingress:
  - hostname: office.example.invalid
    service: http://127.0.0.1:45863
  - service: http_status:404
snippets.dns:
dig +short A office.example.invalid
dig +short CNAME office.example.invalid
curl --fail https://office.example.invalid/build.json
